newsitem.title: UK: Cairn to sell certain assets to Soco. [CORRECTED 09:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Cairn to sell certain assets to Soco. [CORRECTED 09:45 GMT]

text.p: Britain's Cairn Energy Plc said on Wednesday it had agreed to sell certain UK and international assets to Soco International, as part of its flotation plans.
Cairn said in a statement it expects to receive around $40 million in cash plus around 10 percent of the shares in Soco.
"This disposal allows Cairn to realise immediate value for assets no longer material to the Cairn group or within its area of strategic focus," said Cairn's chief executive Bill Gammell.
Soco is being formed by combining the assets of U.S.-based Snyder Oil and Cairn.
A Cairn spokeswoman told Reuters that Snyder will own a 15 to 17 percent interest in Soco. (Corrects from 90 percent)
Soco is seeking a listing on the London stock exchange in May and plans to raise around $75 million of new capital to fund its exploration and development programme.
